newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates ease to close at 19.50 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates ease to close at 19.50 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates dropped on Friday in abundant money supply but slack activity, traders said.
Overnight rates opened between 19.875 and 20.125 percent and eased to 19.50 percent in routine trading compared with Thursday's close of 20.125 percent.
"The rates could have dropped even more but there was little activity on the market," said Sandor Szatmari of Creditanstalt.
He added that the end of tax-payments and money flowing back from the central bank's reverse repo facilities were probably the main reason for today's rate drop.
